test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

One can achieve nothing without hard work.

options.text: Nothing is achieved without hard work.
Nothing will be achieved without hard work.
Nothing has been achieved without hard work.
Nothing can be achieved without hard work.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and needs to be changed to the passive voice.
 
• In a passive voice construction, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb form also changes to include a form of 'to be' along with the past participle of the main verb.
 
• The correct passive construction for the given sentence is: "Nothing can be achieved without hard work."
 
• Here, "**nothing"** becomes the subject, **"can be achieved"** is the passive form of the verb, and "**without hard work**" remains the same.

Hence, the correct statement is:** *Nothing can be achieved without hard work*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In passive voice sentences, the focus is on the action rather than the subject.
 
• It is often used when the subject is unknown, unimportant, or implied.
 
• Example: "**The cake was eaten"** focuses on the action of eating rather than** who ate the cake.**
 
• Using passive voice can also make a sentence sound more formal or objective.
